detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and Potential Driver Issues
suggested_solution: Update BIOS and GPU Drivers to latest versions.
Monitor System Resources and Close unnecessary background applications.
Ensure proper cooling by cleaning dust from the laptop's vents and fans.
Consider upgrading to a more efficient cooling solution or adjusting power settings to prioritize performance over battery life.
Run a stress test (e.g., Unigine Heaven) to identify potential thermal throttling issues.
